result.content: For heatwaves, the main thing to keep in mind is providing constant hydration and shade. You'll want to ensure your plants are getting enough water, and if possible, move any sensitive plants to a shaded or more sheltered spot. You might also want to consider using some kind of evaporative cooling if you can, like misting or using a fan to create a breeze, which can help regulate the air around them without letting them get too hot.
